headline: Domestic financial system remains resilient despite external shocks, says RBI report - OrissaPOST
summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Financial Stability Report said the domestic financial system remains resilient, supported by strong bank and non-bank balance sheets. Scheduled commercial banks are described as safe and sound.
why: The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank and regulator, and its stability assessments shape views on Indian banks and credit conditions.
